title: C: Query Builder (Simulated)
description: Build a simple SQL query builder that constructs SELECT queries programmatically.

steps.title: SELECT Query Builder
steps.description: Define a `Query` struct that holds a char buffer and a length. Write functions `void q_select(Query *q, char *cols)`, `void q_from(Query *q, char *table)`, `void q_where(Query *q, char *condition)`. Build a query: SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18.
hints: Use `strcat` or `sprintf` to append to the buffer.
Each q_ function appends to the query string.
Start with empty buffer, append clauses in order.

verification.test: output.includes('SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18')
verification.failureMessage: Build and print the SELECT query
